title: React Native Developer
summary: As Developer and Functional Analyst for Techint's internal mobile application (EQM), I stabilized a deprecated, offline-first codebase with no test coverage and restored release continuity: 3 versions in the first three months after a year without updates. I then led a migration plan that made AI-assisted development safe on business-critical software: a 2,000+ test suite built as the safety net, followed by the migration of the app's full core from JavaScript to TypeScript with AI agents in about a month, with zero regressions. From day one I earned the client's trust by proposing functional improvements weighed by cost and benefit, delivering value even while the app was still being stabilized — such as a dynamic stepper that lets users move through the whole document-creation process without unnecessary screens. I also own release management and led the first AI agent shipped inside the product.
bullets: Stabilized EQM, a deprecated offline-first React Native app with no test coverage, publishing 3 releases in its first 3 months after a year with no updates.
Designed a JavaScript→TypeScript migration plan around a 2,000+ test suite built from zero, with >80% coverage.
Migrated the app's full core (166 files) from JavaScript to TypeScript with AI agents in ~1 month, with zero functional regressions.
Wrote coding rules and a knowledge base as shared agent context, turning ad-hoc AI use into a consistent, reviewable workflow; added 4 quality gates (lint, format, test, type-check).
Led the first AI agent shipped inside the product itself: a user-facing assistant for daily activity reporting.

Earned the client's trust early as primary liaison with cost/benefit-weighted improvements from day one, like a dynamic stepper that cut unnecessary screens from document creation; owned store releases.
